dedupe_keys.name: kystverket main and secondary fairways hovedled og biled norway s national fairway network of the coast

description: The Norwegian fairway structure, a standardised reference system of fairway categories covering the whole coast. Contents: the catalogue entry says the fairways are set by the regulation on fairways of 11 December 2019 (no. 1834) and that the structure covers the network of sea transport routes as a national geographic reference for management, planning, development and operations in the coastal zone. The WFS read on 29 September 2026 held 1,140 fairway lines plus 27 area limits, and a further dataset gives the area limits of the fairways. Producer: Kystverket. Coverage: the Norwegian coast. Format and access: downloads through Geonorge as FGDB, GML, GeoJSON, KML, PostGIS, SOSI and shapefile, plus WFS; open data, updated annually. Licence: Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD) 2.0, no limitations stated. Caveats: describes the regulatory route network, not vessel behaviour or depths. Simulation uses: the waterway network for maritime traffic flow, port access, spill response and coastal disruption models. Related records: the Kystverket navigation installations record covers the marks along these routes.
